subject: [PATCH v2 06/12] mm/collapse: drop the collapse_possible() wrapper

2026-09-10.patch_summary: This patch removes a wrapper function called collapse_possible() that simply forwards to another function called collapse_possible_orders(). The three callers of collapse_possible() can directly test the mask returned by collapse_possible_orders(), eliminating the need for an extra function call. This change has no functional impact and is a minor optimization.
